appearance.explanation: P2 starts198; XuShu is already a Belong0 resident in XiangYang. No additional birthday/Appear wait is required. PersonUpDatadate adds people only on a future matching birth+16 year, invoked at year wrap; that is separate from SearchDrv eligibility.

properMenu.path: Real current city root 内政 -> actual submenu 搜寻 -> current native owned person picker selects 蒯良110.
properMenu.creation: SearchMake requires current GetCityPersons plus IsManual/IsMoney, consumes original costs, shows original searcher speech, inserts SEARCH order TimeCount0; only successful AddOrderHead then removes searcher with DelPerson.
properMenu.nativeOwnership: Menu kind/context/seq and IDs are current observations; names or a historical city shell cannot authorize another Enter/Exit.
properMenu.quantityBoundary: Recruitment/distribution and march food may later have true qty owners; SearchMake itself has no amount field.

searchExecution.policy: Current PolicyExec executes every non0xff order once through OrderExec/SearchDrv and then DelOrder. Search TimeCount0 is not a multi-month timer; player must genuinely finish the strategy phase.
searchExecution.return: SearchDrv ends with AddPerson(Order->City,searcher), whether it finds nothing, money, food, a tool, another person, or XuShu.
searchExecution.date: Only original ConditionUpdate advances month by1 after order execution; at12->1 year+1 and appearance updates. Do not write dates, direct-call PolicyExec/SearchDrv, or skip computer strategy.
randomGates: gam_rand()%4 must select branch1 for people/tools, not0 nothing/2 money/3 food.
First rnd=gam_rand()%150 must be below searcherIQ and even for person branch; odd leads to a tool attempt.
GetCityOutPersons current Belong0 list is sampled by gam_rand()%count; four initial candidates exist, so XuShu is not a selectable deterministic target.
bole=0 enters a new gam_rand()%110 < searcherIQ test. It is neither automatic success nor rejection.
On success only, actual target.Belong becomes searcher.Belong (expected13), Devotion=70+gam_rand()%30. Failed visit leaves target unowned.

uniformHeuristicOnly.warning: Approximation assumes independent uniform draws and unchanged four-person pool; not a native measured probability, budget or success guarantee. Actual pool, AI, money, food and ownership can change naturally.

whyNotCanvass.source: CanvassMake uses GetEnemyPersons(g_PlayerKing), which includes only different nonzero city owners and a resident whose Person.Belong equals that enemy owner; excludes enemy lords.
whyNotCanvass.conclusion: XuShu rawBelong0 inside player-owned city26 is not a valid CANVASS target. Native 招降 likewise requires captured people, not this out-of-service resident. Correct initial path is 搜寻.

reports.searcherCreation: Original random P_SAY_STR21..23 speech for nonlord searcher, acknowledged under actual report owner.
reports.result: Success/refusal can show searcher and target reports; other branches report nothing/money/food/tool. Do not equate name appearing in a report with allied ownership.

minimumReasonableProcedure: Start a private original P2 LiuBiao game and verify actual dynLib SHA/current city26; preserve original queue/date/money/reserve/orders.
Issue one actual SEARCH using an eligible current high-IQ owned resident (prefer 蒯良110), acknowledge only observed reports, then genuine Back/strategy end through current owners.

Wait original execution, all actual reports, returned searcher and next map input; record new date/world/out-person list. If XuShu is not truly Belong13 and in current owned picker, retain failure and continue only within an explicit player-command budget; no guaranteed first month.

After actual acquisition, require U16 current picker/menu IDs contain171 and show actual name/Belong13. Genuine recruitment/distribution as needed, then original city26->20 dispatch receipt; select XuShu171 first and ally刘琦115 second.
At battle/map111 current actual positions/state/MP, legally stay the caster and select current skillID20, not a guessed menu index; baseline-only may cancel and legally rest without casting.

For a later actual cast, fresh native AIM must authorize current living same-side ally; success is actual movie39/skill20/actor+target, actual ally state0->4 plus native state report, not a manufactured event.
